I or T: B1 [ I or T ] to remove things from a suitcase, bag, or box
從（箱、包）中取出；打開行李箱

T: › [ T ] to explain or examine something in order to make its meaning clearer

example: I haven't even had time to unpack (my suitcase/clothes).
我甚至還沒有時間打開箱子整理／把衣服從箱子裡拿出來。
He read the agreed statement to the group and then began to unpack it for them.
他把已達成一致的聲明讀給這群人聽，然後開始向他們解釋其意義。

NONE: C1 An unpaid debt, tax, etc. has not been paid.
（債務、稅等）未支付的，未償付的
C1 Unpaid work is work that you do without getting any money for it.
無償的，免費的，沒有報酬的

example: $50,000 in unpaid taxes
五萬美元的未付稅款

NONE: › An unpalatable fact or idea is unpleasant or shocking and therefore difficult to accept.
（事實或想法）令人不快的，讓人難以接受的
› Unpalatable food is unpleasant to taste or eat.
（食物）難以下嚥的，不可口的

example: the unpalatable truth/facts about the war
令人難以接受的戰爭真相／事實

NONE: › having no equal; better or greater than any other
無雙的，無比的；空前的

example: They enjoyed success on a scale unparalleled by any previous rock band.
他們取得了以前任何搖滾樂隊都無法比擬的成功。

NONE: › (of behaviour) too bad to forgive or be accepted
（行為）過於惡劣無法饒恕的

example: They had committed an unpardonable sin.
他們犯了無法饒恕的罪過。

NONE: › not worried about something, especially when this is slightly surprising
（尤指在意外情況下）不擔憂的；鎮靜的；平靜的

example: He seemed completely unperturbed at the idea of having to sing in a room full of strangers.
他似乎一點都不擔心在一屋子陌生人面前唱歌。

T: › to cut or remove the stitches from a line of sewing
› If you unpick a difficult subject, you separate and examine its different parts carefully.
› to gradually destroy or remove the good effects of what someone has done or created
（逐漸）破壞，毀掉已取得的成績

example: He expertly unpicks the significant features of each painting.
他專業地深入剖析每一幅畫的重要特徵。
If I try to unpick my own motivation, I think mostly I was jealous.
如果要我深入剖析我自己的動機，我想在極大程度上是嫉妒。
The former leader now has to watch his successor unpicking what he strived so hard to achieve.
這位前任領導現在不得不眼睜睜地看著他的繼任者一點點地毀掉他辛苦開創的局面。

NONE: › used to refer to percussion instruments that do not produce sounds of a definite pitch
（打擊樂器）沒有固定音高標準的
› in horse racing, a horse that is not one of the first three to finish a race
（賽馬中）未獲得前三名的，未獲得名次的

example: The sole British runner, White Knight, was unplaced.
英國唯一參賽的賽馬「白色騎士」沒能獲得名次。

NONE: › not planned or expected
沒有計劃的；意料之外的

example: an unplanned pregnancy
意外懷孕

NONE: › An unplayable ball is hit or thrown so hard or skilfully that it is impossible to hit.
（球）無法擊打的
› If an area of ground that is usually used for sports is unplayable, it cannot be played on, especially because of bad weather conditions.
（場地尤因天氣條件很糟而）不適宜比賽的
› A piece of music that is unplayable is too difficult to perform.
（樂曲）太難而無法演奏的
B1 not enjoyable or pleasant
令人不快的，使人討厭的

after verb: C1 [ after verb ] rude and angry

example: an unpleasant surprise
令人不快的意外
the unpleasant truth
使人感覺不舒服的真相
When we complained, the waiter got very unpleasant with us.
當我們投訴時，這個服務生對我們相當不禮貌。

T: › to take the plug of a piece of electrical equipment out of the place where it is connected to the electricity supply
› US to remove what is blocking something

example: Did you unplug the iron?
你拔下熨斗的插頭了嗎？
The video shows you how to unplug a bath drain full of hair.
這段視頻向你展示如何疏通一個完全被頭髮堵塞的浴缸下水道。

NONE: › used to refer to musicians performing without electric instruments and without amplification (= electronic equipment that makes sound louder)
（音樂演奏）不插電（的）
B2 not liked by many people
不普及的；不流行的；不受歡迎的

example: Night flights from the airport are unpopular.
從該機場出發的夜間航班非常不受歡迎。
The president is becoming increasingly unpopular.
總統變得越來越不得人心。

NONE: C2 never having happened or existed in the past
史無前例的，空前的；絕無僅有的

example: This century has witnessed environmental destruction on an unprecedented scale.
環境在本世紀遭到了空前的破壞。

NONE: B2 likely to change suddenly and without reason and therefore not able to be predicted (= expected before it happens) or depended on
變幻莫測的；難以預見的，無法預測的

example: The weather there can be unpredictable - one minute it's blue skies and the next minute it's pouring rain.
那裡的天氣有點兒變幻莫測—— 一會兒晴空萬裡，一會兒又大雨滂沱。
The hours in this job are very unpredictable - you sometimes have to work late at very short notice.
這份工作的時間非常不固定——有時突然接到通知就得工作到很晚。

NONE: › (especially of a crime or something unpleasant) done without being planned
（犯罪等）不是有預謀的，非事前策劃的

example: Opposite
premeditated

NONE: › not prepared; not ready
沒有準備的；措手不及的

example: He was completely/totally/wholly unprepared for what he saw.
他對眼前的場面毫無準備。
The extreme cold weather caught them unprepared.
極端寒冷的天氣讓他們措手不及。

NONE: › not interesting, attractive, or impressive
無趣的，乏味的；沒有吸引力的

example: We were disappointed at the unprepossessing exterior of the hotel.
我們對旅館乏味的外表感到失望。

NONE: › simple and/or sincere; not pretentious
不矯飾的；低調的，不張揚的

example: The food is delicious and unpretentious.
這種食物樣子普通，但味道可口。
Opposite
pretentious

NONE: › having or showing no moral rules or standards of good behaviour
不道德的；無原則的；無恥的
› containing offensive language and therefore not acceptable in printed form, for example in a newspaper
（因含有髒字或其他冒犯性語言）不宜刊行的，不宜發表的

example: He was known for his incendiary remarks, most of them unprintable in a family newspaper.
他以發表煽動性言論聞名，許多不宜刊登在以家庭為目標讀者的報紙上。

NONE: C1 not producing very much
收益很少的；效果不明顯的
C1 not having positive results
徒然的；無效的

example: Opposite
productive
It was such an unproductive meeting - we didn't make a single decision.
這是場徒勞無功的會議——我們連一項決議也沒有做出。

NONE: C1 not showing the standard of behaviour or skill that is expected of a person in a skilled job
不專業的；業餘的；違反職業行爲準則的

example: Doctor Rivers was charged with unprofessional conduct and improper use of dangerous drugs.
瑞弗斯醫生被指控行為違法職業行為準則，並且不當使用危險藥物。

NONE: › not making a profit
不盈利的，虧本的

example: Rural railway lines risk being axed because they are unprofitable.
鄉村鐵路線有被取消的風險，因為無法盈利。

NONE: › Something that is unpromising does not show any signs that it will be enjoyable or successful.
前景不妙的；沒希望的

example: The car broke down, which was an unpromising start to the holiday.
汽車壞了，這個假期剛一開始就前景不妙。

NONE: › without being told to say or do something
主動的，自發的，未經敦促的

example: Jim was remarkably charming this evening - he even said, unprompted, how nice Margot looked in her dress.
吉姆今晚格外招人喜歡——他甚至主動讚美瑪戈穿那件連衣裙很漂亮。

NONE: › difficult to say or (of something written) difficult to know how to say
難發音的；拗口的

example: Scotch whiskies have great character and unpronounceable names, like Bruichladdich.
蘇格蘭威士卡有很強的特色和難以念出來的名字，比如布魯克拉迪。

NONE: › not protected and therefore able to be harmed or damaged
無防備的；未受保護的
› sexual activity without a condom
無防護措施的性行為，未使用避孕套的性行為

example: Water and other liquids can stain unprotected wood surfaces.
水和其他液體會汙損未加保護的木材表面。
Although some marine mammals are protected by environmental laws, many remain unprotected.
儘管有一些海洋哺乳動物受到了環境法的保護，但還有很多不在其中。
The lack of a shell leaves the larvae unprotected against predators.
沒有外殼保護使這些幼蟲不能抵禦天敵的捕食。

NONE: › not having been shown to be good enough or to be able to do something
尚未獲得證明的
› not having been shown to be true
尚未證實的；未經檢驗的

example: It would be unwise to throw billions at unproven technology.
向還未證實可行的技術投入億萬資金是不明智的。
a group of talented but unproven young players
一群有才智但還未證明自己能力的隊員
Unproven allegations have ruined his career.
未經證實的指控毀了他的職業前途。
The suspicion, as yet unproven in court, is that he may have withheld important information.
有懷疑稱他可能隱藏了重要信息，但這一點尚未獲法庭證實。

NONE: › If an unpleasant action or remark is unprovoked, it has not been caused by anything and is therefore unfair.
（令人不快的言行）無端的，無緣無故的

example: an unprovoked attack on her character
對她人格的無端攻擊

NONE: › written but not yet published
未出版的，未發表的

example: After his death, his daughter found an unpublished manuscript among his papers.
他死後，女兒在他的文件中發現了一部未發表的手稿。
a collection of unpublished poems
未發表的詩集

NONE: › not punished
未受懲罰的

example: If a referee allows a foul like that to go unpunished he's asking for trouble.
如果裁判對那樣的犯規都不給予處罰，那他就是在自尋麻煩。

NONE: › If a book is unputdownable, it is so exciting that you do not want to stop reading it.
（書）令人愛不釋手的，令人不忍釋卷的，引人入勝的

example: "Was it a good read?" "Oh, totally unputdownable - I finished it in two days."
「那本書好看嗎？」「噢，簡直讓人愛不釋手——我兩天就看完了。」
